description: Use this when the user wants to book, reserve a place, sign up a child or children, or book for a group for one specific Horseback event or group activity from the lists in eventId / productId (eventId = the id of an event page in get_activities; productId = "<category id>/<activity id>" from get_activities). It sends the same pre-reservation as the "Wstępna rezerwacja" form on the activity page: no payment is taken, nothing is confirmed yet - Horseback calls or texts the user to confirm the date and details. Before calling, collect from the user: (1) a phone number; (2) for an event (eventId): the number of children and their ages (childrenInfo; for adult events, the number of participants), and the variant (eventVariant) when the event has more than one; for a group activity (productId): the number of people and the age of the group (groupInfo); (3) consent: ask the user directly whether they agree that Horseback contacts them by phone or SMS about this reservation, and pass consent: true only after they said yes. Send one call per event or activity. Do not include other personal data (names, health information). Do not use for payment, for activities not in the lists, or without the user's explicit consent. It does not confirm a date. Data controller: Horseback Sp. z o.o.; privacy policy: https://horseback.pl/polityka-prywatnosci (English: https://horseback.pl/polityka-prywatnosci?lang=en). Variants: warsztaty-rozwojowe-z-konmi-dla-kobiet: "Warsztaty jednodniowe" or "Warsztaty dwudniowe (z noclegiem i wyżywieniem)"; sylwester-jezdziecki: "Grupa starsza (10:00-12:30)" or "Grupa młodsza (11:30-13:30)".

childrenInfo.description: Events only, required: number of children and their ages, e.g. "2 children: 7 and 10 years old" (adult events: number of participants).

consent.description: true only after the user explicitly agreed that Horseback contacts them by phone or SMS about this reservation.

eventId.description: Event id (event page slug). Give either eventId or productId, not both.

eventVariant.description: Events with more than one variant only, required there: the variant name exactly as listed in this tool description.

groupInfo.description: Group activities (productId) only, required: number of people and the age of the group, e.g. "15 people, adults".

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

phone.description: Phone number of the user: 9 digits (Polish number, e.g. "601 234 567") or international format with + (e.g. "+48601234567", "+4915112345678").

productId.description: Group activity id "<category>/<slug>". Give either eventId or productId, not both.

name: create_prereservation
title: Wstępna rezerwacja
